messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout 'sdk@8.2.0' to api-paging (canary=5%) — image: redwood/api-paging:8.2.0
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/search/paged in canary cluster (us-east-2) — error rate 12% over 2m — auto-escalating to P1
aj: seeing the same in metrics, CPU looks normal but tail latency up and a spike in 502s. pulling request logs now.
vincent: rolling tails show a lot of 'cursor: invalid encoding' errors from json.Unmarshal at paging/cursor.go:142
maria: @aj can you paste the failing log lines? I want to check request examples — I'm oncall and will take lead.
aj: paste logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:31:05Z ERROR handler: request_id=abc123 path=/v1/search/paged msg="cursor decode failed" err="illegal base64 data at input byte 22"
2026-03-15T02:31:06Z ERROR handler: request_id=def456 path=/v1/search/paged msg="cursor decode failed" err="illegal base64 data at input byte 8"
```
aj: looks like cursors issued by 8.1.0 are not decodable by 8.2.0 due to a change in the cursor encoding (we switched to url-safe base64 in the new SDK without a compatibility shim).
cs-olivia: we already have two paying customers (Acme Ads, SkylineApps) on Dedicated who reported pagination failing for some users, ticket numbers #2345 #2346. They're seeing users stuck on page 2/3.
maria: OK this is bad. Impacting paginated queries for clients that use opaque cursors. Priority P1 with SLO impact. Plan: kill the canary, flip feature flag cursor_v2=false globally for traffic, rollback the deployment if flag flip doesn't restore behaviour. @aj can you attempt ff-kill now?
aj: running ff-kill (console):
```
$ redwood-ffctl set cursor_v2 false --env=prod --scope=canary,global
Setting flag cursor_v2=false in cluster canary... done
Setting flag cursor_v2=false in cluster global... done
```
ops-robot: Feature flag cursor_v2 set to false globally by aj — propagation to edge services ~15s
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Flag updated. Monitor for error reduction.
vincent: after ff flip errors dropped to ~1.2% within 30s. Looks like flag controls the new cursor code path.
maria: good. Keep monitoring for 5m. Meanwhile, we need a mitigation checklist: 1) keep flag off globally, 2) cut a patch to accept both encodings (compat decode), 3) prepare rollback of 8.2.0 in case flag flip fails to cover some clients, 4) inform CS and affected customers.
aj: I'll open a hotfix branch and patch cursor decoder to try legacy base64 fallback. Drafting PR now.
cs-olivia: telling customers: "We identified a compatibility regression in the pagination cursor encoding introduced in an internal SDK rollout. We've disabled the new cursor mode and are rolling out a fix. No account data was exposed; this affects only pagination continuation tokens. We'll update within 1 hour."
maria: handoff to next oncall @vincent in 20m. Vincent, what I need from you on handoff: 1) keep cursor_v2=false until a tested fix is deployed, 2) validate canary for non-regression, 3) coordinate rollback if we see remaining errors >2% for 10 minutes.
vincent: ack. I'll take oncall in 20. I want the PR link and QA steps. @aj paste PR link when ready.
aj: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1289 — adds legacy base64 fallback, unit + integration tests, feature flag gate. CI passing on unit, integration running.
sre-bot: Canary health check: error rate now 0.9% (down from 12%) — rolling averages look stable.
maria: great. I will file the incident start note and tag support. cs-olivia please add the customer messages and update the two tickets.
cs-olivia: done. Updated Acme Ads and SkylineApps with current mitigation and ETA for code fix next deploy window (15 min).
ops-robot: Rollback command prepared if needed:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-paging --to-revision=347
```
maria: If PR passes integration, let's do a controlled canary of the fix behind the flag (cursor_v2=false by default) and then enable per-canary. If all green, re-enable cursor_v2 with a 0.1% ramp and watch errors.
vincent: sounds good. I'll own the canary unmute and the watch. Handoff complete. Leaving thread open for updates.
incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged — handoff to vincent at 2734567910. Tagging postmortem owner: @maria.
vincent: (10m later) Integration tests passed and canary deployed with compat decoder; monitoring shows no spike. Preparing to re-enable cursor_v2 in canary for a tiny ramp to validate new behavior against old clients.
aj: enabling cursor_v2 for canary 0.1% now.
ops-robot: cursor_v2=true set for cluster canary only.
vincent: watching — no increase in 5xx. After 30m of stability, we'll consider safe to re-enable wider.
maria: excellent. Closing immediate impact: mitigated by ff-kill and compat patch. Action items: write postmortem (owner: maria), add regression tests for cursor compatibility, add canary decoder mismatch alert, update SDK release notes mentioning cursor encoding change and compatibility mode.
cs-olivia: CS follow-up done, customers acknowledged.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident moved to monitoring. Last updated 2734567960
